inputs.text: [shaken] You nearly went down. I knew you were going to kick it, but I didn't know you were going to throw your whole weight after it.
[breathless] Neither did I. My foot slipped. Are you all right? You caught me with the arm it just hurt.
[shaken] I'll find out when we aren't doing this. For now, stay close enough that I don't have to catch you from across the room.
[breathless] Harry, I'm not trying to make this harder for you. I saw it coming and there wasn't time to do it neatly.
[shaken] I know you weren't. I thought I'd lost you for a second. That's what I'm trying to say.
[shaken] It isn't just in the glass anymore. Look past the chair. It's here, and it's still doing what we do.
